title: Minimum Number Game
summary: Alice and Bob play a game with an even-length integer array nums.
statement: Alice and Bob play a game with an even-length integer array nums. In each round, Alice removes the smallest element, then Bob removes the smallest element. Bob appends his element to arr, followed by Alice appending hers. The process repeats until nums is empty. The function returns the array arr.
constraints: Repeatedly remove the smallest remaining value for Alice and then the smallest for Bob.
Append Bob’s value followed by Alice’s value until nums is empty; return the constructed array.
hints: Repeated minimum removals are revealed by sorting all values once.
In each adjacent sorted pair, Alice receives the first and Bob the second.
Append each pair in second-then-first order.
Sorting gives exactly the removal sequence, so swapping each consecutive pair reproduces the game.
editorial: Sorting gives exactly the removal sequence, so swapping each consecutive pair reproduces the game.

tests.explanation: Sorted pairs (2,3) and (4,5) are appended in swapped order, yielding [3,2,5,4].
Alice removes two, Bob removes five, and the answer is [5,2].
